other_conditions: Total family income must be less than Rs 10,000 per month in rural areas and less than Rs 12,000 per month in urban areas.
Total family land holding must be less than 3 acres of wet land or less than 10 acres of dry land (or combined up to 10 acres).
No family member should be a government employee or pensioner (families of sanitary workers are exempted).
The family should not own a four‑wheeler (taxi, tractor and auto are exempted).
Monthly electricity consumption of the dwelling unit must be under 300 units.
No family member should be an income‑tax payer.
Built‑up area of any municipal property must be less than 1,000 sq ft.
Applicant must not already be covered under YSR Pension Kanuka.
Eligibility is limited to women belonging to BC, SC, ST or Minority communities.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹75,000 payable in four phases over four years.
